description: Shannon Taylor, Henrico's top prosecutor and candidate for Virginia's 1st Congressional District, joined SEIU and the Campaign for a Family Friendly Economy PAC for a roundtable on how Rob Wittman's votes to gut healthcare are hitting families and care workers across the district.

title: Prosecutor Shannon Taylor Hosts Roundtable Discussion on Rob Wittman's Votes to Slash Virginians’ Healthcare - Shannon Taylor for Virginia
